pattern_explanation: Each of these Portuguese words descends from Latin roots, so its spelling resembles an English word. Over the centuries the meanings drifted apart, so the form can mislead an English reader even though the word is a different one.
false_friend_warning: Watch out: the Portuguese word meaning bookshop looks like the English word 'library', and the Portuguese word meaning currently looks like the English word 'actually'. Matching by spelling gives the wrong English meaning in both cases.
